text:
elena: Thanks for joining the all-hands Q&A thread. Quick follow-up on the reliability segment: sharing RCA + a short action checklist. RCA link: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-42
sam: Got it — will triage the 'cache eviction' action today. Assigning to @kevin
kevin: on it. short question: do we prefer the hotfix or config flag route?
maria: logwise, the hotfix needs a config fallback. config flag is safer for rollback.
sam: +1 to config flag for safety, but we should timeline it.
elena: timeline = can we ship flag + monitor by EOD Friday? target: 48h for rollback tests.
kevin: EOD Friday ok, I’ll open the PR and tag reviewers. I'll include a short smoke test: `curl -X POST ...`
jon: I can own the rollout plan and the canary window. I’ll coordinate with infra for capacity.
incident-bot: New RCA published: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-42 — summary: cache eviction bug + fallback missing; severity: Sev2.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook draft updated at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cache-eviction — please review.
elena: action items: 1) PR (kevin) 2) Rollout + canary (jon) 3) Monitoring alert (maria) 4) Postmortem slides (sam)
kevin: PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/commit/abc123 — requesting reviews from @maria @jon
maria: will add alert thresholds and dashboards by tomorrow morning.
jon: setting canary window 15m with traffic ramp 5%->50% in 3 steps.
sam: I’ll draft 3-slide postmortem and link in this thread when ready.
elena: for leadership Q: do we need a customer-facing note? thoughts?
kevin: not yet. impact was internal; NPS not affected afaict.
maria: ops metrics show 0.2% error spike, no customer-facing incident.
elena: ok – no customer note. please use the RCA link in external comms only after legal review.
jon: small ask — can infra whitelist the canary hosts for monitoring? tagging @infra-team
kevin: added infra ticket: https://infra.internal/tickets/54321
sam: I'll post the slide link here when ready: https://redwood.internal/slides/postmortem-cache-eviction
elena: thank you all. looping back in Friday EOD for confirmation. :party_parrot:
kevin: quick note: I'll include a rollback script in the PR: `scripts/rollback_cache_flag.sh`
maria: adding runbook snippet:
```
if redis_eviction_rate > 0.5%:
  set config cache_eviction_safe=true
  alert ops
```
sam: done w/ draft slides, sharing in thread now.
elena: perfect — closing this thread after EOD check-in. ping here with ✅ when done.
kevin: ✅ PR merged to main, rolling canary now.
jon: Canary 5% -> 20% after 5m, no regressions.
maria: dashboards look stable.
elena: ✅ great work team. I'll summarize and add to the all-hands notes.
